connector.name: Cuba Memorys
connector.registryDescription: Persistent memory MCP server. 29 tools, BM25+MMR+OOD retrieval, CFR-21 audit, code graph.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cuba-memorys. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the leandropg19 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CUBA_PROJECT_FILTER
env.description: Set to 'off' to disable v0.8 project scoping filters (admin/debug only).

env.name: CUBA_JUDGE
env.description: cuba_juez backend selector: claude_cli | anthropic_api | heuristic | auto (default auto).

env.name: CUBA_JUEZ_MODEL
env.description: Model name passed to the judge backend (default 'claude-haiku-4-5').

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: API key for AnthropicApiJudge (only used when feature 'anthropic-api' is built in).

env.name: CUBA_REM_RELATION_BATCH
env.description: Isolated entities the REM cycle scans for relations per run (default 5, 0 disables).

env.name: CUBA_RERANKER_PATH
env.description: Directory holding the bge-reranker ONNX model; enables cross-encoder reranking (+93% nDCG on GPU).

env.name: CUBA_RERANK_FIXED_SHAPE
env.description: Pad reranker batches to a constant 512 tokens. Defaults on for GPU builds, off on CPU.
